mapper.sql: SELECT a.*,p.title program_title FROM application a JOIN program p ON p.id=a.program_id
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(id) FROM document_intake WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND status='APPLIED'
SELECT * FROM application WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id=#{ownerId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application(workspace_id,program_id,owner_id,application_round) SELECT #{workspaceId},#{programId},#{ownerId},COALESCE(MAX(application_round),0)+1 FROM application WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND program_id=#{programId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId}

INSERT INTO staff_assignment(application_id,staff_id,assigned_by,reason) VALUES(#{applicationId},#{staffId},#{assignedBy},#{reason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE staff_id=VALUES(staff_id),assigned_by=VALUES(assigned_by),reason=VALUES(reason),assigned_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT h.*,u.display_name FROM application_status_history h JOIN app_user u ON u.id=h.actor_id WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} ORDER BY h.id
SELECT id,revision_no,submitted_at FROM application_revision WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} ORDER BY revision_no DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document d WHERE d.application_id=#{applicationId} AND d.type_code=#{type} AND d.version=(SELECT MAX(n.version) FROM document n WHERE n.application_id=d.application_id AND n.type_code=d.type_code) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM revision_document rd JOIN application_revision r ON r.id=rd.revision_id WHERE rd.document_id=d.id AND r.application_id=#{applicationId} AND r.revision_no=(SELECT MAX(revision_no) FROM application_revision WHERE application_id=#{applicationId}))
SELECT d.* FROM document d JOIN revision_document rd ON rd.document_id=d.id WHERE rd.revision_id=#{revisionId} ORDER BY d.type_code
